text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Good start to year on Casablanca Stock Exchange gives hope that it will be able to meet the challenge for more savings by Moroccans.
- King Hassan meets Congolese and Angolan envoys.
- Marrakesh university witnesses disruptions after arrest of 14 students for throwing stones at guards during identity checks.
- Floods and European Union constraints on distribution put Moroccan citrus growers in difficult position.

- Absence of a core of shareholders for oil refinery Samir prevents stock from gaining value on the bourse. Government reported to have commissioned foreign specialist to launch tender for remaining stake.
